name: @claude-image-gen/mcp
description: Stdio MCP server for OpenAI gpt-image-2 and Google Gemini image generation.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --external:sharp --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); process.stderr.write('[image-gen] boot node=' + process.version + '\n');"
